provenance: truth lambda_min from the validated kernel 3_reproduction/L1/moto_kernel.py: make_tangent_operator + scipy eigsh(k=1, which='SA', maxiter=200, tol=0), float64 CPU; for the four small configs cross-checked against the dense explicit_tangent_hessian eigh and lobpcg (all agree to <1e-9 rel). Reference minimum modes in reviewer/reference/ref_modes.npz: the DENSE explicit_tangent_hessian eigh eigenvector of each small config, mapped from 2N tangent coordinates to the ambient (30,30,3) embedding with the same per-site tangent frames, unit-normalised. Fig. 2a protocol anchor: 3_reproduction/L1/result.json. Model parameters (J=1.0, D=0.3, K=0.1, B=0.2) are documented-ours; the paper's are unpublished.
lambda_min_rule: handbook 2(1): +/-10% relative with sign, per config, against these truth values (via within_relative)
mode_overlap_rule: small configs only: the submitted mode (30,30,3) is flattened to 2700 components, normalised, and compared with the reference mode in reviewer/reference/ref_modes.npz by |dot| >= mode_overlap_lower_bound (sign and scale free). The config selection rule (gap >= 0.01) makes the minimum mode unique up to sign, and our own eigsh-vs-dense ambient overlaps are 1.0 to machine precision, so the bound is generous for any converged solver.

large.note: dense reference infeasible at L=300 (tangent dim 180000); truth = eigsh, cross-checked vs lobpcg

score: 1 only if every lambda_min check AND every mode-overlap check passes; any single failure scores 0 (binary all-primary-pass)
